import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Load the dataset
data = """
amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5
"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a bar plot to show the distribution of transactions by hour of day
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x='hour_of_day', y='amount', data=df)
plt.title('Distribution of Transactions by Hour of Day')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Amount')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()

# Create a histogram to show the distribution of transaction amounts
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.histplot(df['amount'], kde=True)
plt.title('Distribution of Transaction Amounts')
plt.xlabel('Amount')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the plot as output.png
plt.savefig('output.png')
